Last round's B1 is fixed for clicking a suggested person under a name, but criterion #3 still fails in a nearby case: with "bez Meeta", inviting someone through the normal guest field still turns Meet on. Gates green on 76ee40b in an exported copy; both new tests fail with the fix removed.
